auditLog.action: Open sidebar and check links for role isolation
auditLog.expected: Sidebar opens, contains Mfg links, does NOT contain admin links

auditLog.expected: Banner explains history and next steps

auditLog.action: Verify presence of executive links (Approvals, Manufacturer Management)

auditLog.action: Verify orientation banner in approvals queue
auditLog.expected: Guidance explaining approval and rejection actions

auditLog.action: Verify orientation guidance on manufacturer directory
auditLog.expected: Explains direct contract vs marketing subscription

auditLog.action: Verify logistics packhouse statistics and seaport links

auditLog.expected: Appropriate pane becomes active and unhidden
